correctness.rationale: For uniform permutations on [n], the full strict left-to-right upper-record set S contains position1. Every maximal nonrecord interval of length ℓ immediately follows a greater record value; permuting values within that interval cannot alter the fixed record-position pattern, and product symmetric-group invariance makes the interval relative orders independent uniform permutations. Each interval contributes one obligatory left-boundary descent and an ordinary Eulerian(ℓ) internal descent count, giving E[t^D|R=S]=t^m ∏ A_ℓ(t)/ℓ!. Adjacent descent indicator covariance -1/12 gives mean (Z+m)/2 and variance Σ_{ℓ>=2}(ℓ+1)/12, including ℓ=1 zero. For fixed K record positions, valid nonrecord block-length compositions have m<=K and total Z=n-K; optimizing singleton count s using 12Var=Z+m-2s gives sharp lower 0 if Z<=K else (Z-K+2)/12 and upper 0 if Z<=1 else (Z+min(K,floor(Z/2)))/12, with constructions attaining each. Independent brute-force permutations n=1..8 checked the entire conditional PGF for every record set and relevant moments. These finite tests do not prove the formulas for all n.
